title: LG’s RGB LED TV is good for certain situations, but an OLED is better
description: When it comes to TVs, the LG name has long been synonymous with OLEDs, continually leading Samsung and Sony as the top OLED manufacturer. But 2026 is all about RGB LED TVs.
